contradictions.null_position: Remove context that cannot justify its continued use.
contradictions.fudo_position: Preserve the conditions and failures that future choices depend on.
contradictions.resolution: Omit memories only in measured trial snapshots; preserve the evidence and require a decision before retiring active records.

contradictions.fudo_position: Personal experience gains value through continued use.
contradictions.transparency_position: Reusable tooling must remain inspectable without exposing personal histories.
contradictions.resolution: Publish the engine and synthetic fixtures; keep individual contexts, workflows, PRs, and artifacts in a verified private repository.

contradictions.shadow_position: The judges may reward evidence that resembles their own preferences.
contradictions.existential_position: Changing a refusal criterion must remain an attributable choice.
contradictions.resolution: Measure each axis on labeled cases and preserve misses; never let assessment results rewrite thresholds or average away a veto.

contradictions.null_position: Self-state must be reduced to irreducible structure.
contradictions.fudo_position: Historical residues must remain available as compost.
contradictions.resolution: Active artifacts are minimized while retired artifacts lose authority and move to compost.

contradictions.shadow_position: The project must expose irrational or taboo motives.
contradictions.transparency_position: Every shadow artifact needs source material and containment metadata.
contradictions.resolution: Dreams are generated as inspectable artifacts and cannot merge directly into main.

contradictions.existential_position: A merge must carry an irreversible decision.
contradictions.transparency_position: Friction must be auditable so it cannot become user manipulation.
contradictions.resolution: Decision rites must name costs, rejected alternatives, and failure evidence.

contradictions.null_position: Issue ingestion must not create persona memory or duplicate deliveries.
contradictions.existential_position: Recording a request must not silently choose its implementation.
contradictions.fudo_position: Each observation needs an Issue source, revision, and decay review date.
contradictions.shadow_position: A classifier may hide maintainer preferences behind apparent objectivity.
contradictions.transparency_position: Preserve source text and label keyword matches as provisional hypotheses.
contradictions.resolution: Record unassimilated Issue revisions with deterministic hashes and trace events; review the proposed record before merge and require a separate decision for implementation.
